expected.title: The defaults unit fails on a dangling `~/.claude/settings.json` symlink
expected.detail: GNU `cp` refuses to write through a destination symlink whose target is missing, so the unit fails and the Claude default settings are never written; a dotfiles checkout without `settings.json` leaves exactly that state on the persistent home volume.
